scope: actual findPendingTimers prepared statements on durable disposable fixtures; query planning evidence, not writer interference acceptance
decision: No new timer index. Preserve ordinary writer key domain, WAL/index maintenance and HOT opportunities. Broad manual reads remain deadline-bound; any automatic consumer must declare the 100,000-row measured envelope and limit timer refreshes to at most one every five seconds per shared view, then pass integrated interference validation. Larger ledgers require new evidence before automatic refresh.
limitations: One EXPLAIN sample per case; execution times are diagnostics, not latency distributions or writer acceptance.
Warm cache and concurrent machine activity vary; normal planner and durable settings recorded per sample.
